user_direction: Evaluate arXiv:2501.19399v1 next instead of centering.

source.title: Scalable-Softmax Is Superior for Attention
source.variant: Section 3 configuration (c), fixed s=1 without learnable scaling or bias

single_change: Multiply each normalized/rotated query by log(n), where n is its full visible causal key count, before the existing softmax attention. Retain XSA and the scaled Peri-RMS parent; do not subtract a prefix mean.
equation: Attention row i = softmax(log(i+1) * original_scores_i) over keys j<=i. For cached execution, i includes the complete shared and private prefix.
adaptations: Use the paper's parameter-free s=1 variant. Keep the benchmark's fixed Q/K temperature, Q/K RMS, RoPE base, initialization, dimensions, native AdamW, LR x2, warmup and budgets. No RoPE extrapolation experiment and no learned scale/bias are imported.
implementation_cautions: Scale queries AFTER Q/K RMS so normalization does not absorb the intended factor.
Use global visible-key counts in dense, chunked and shared-prefix caches.
At n=1 log(n)=0; scale finite queries before masking, avoiding 0*(-infinity).
Keep attention row sums one and use the original centered-XSA evaluation, with no causal-centering correction.
hypothesis: Length-dependent sharpening may improve useful attention selection while retaining mean aggregation and positive normalized weights. This is an empirical hypothesis, especially for the benchmark's short contexts.
guarantee_targets: State and check a finite logit-margin probability bound with exact hypotheses; retain the Peri-RMS state bounds. Do not claim unconditional attention concentration, bounded full-network gradients or faster grokking. Equal logits remain uniform. Removing Q/K RMS removes its uniform raw-score bound; post-branch RMS still bounds each residual contribution.
screen_policy: Keep original budgets. Require 18/18 passes and improvement in at least three of the six per-task median paired epoch ratios versus LR x2 to advance. Preserve every screen row. No screen-only aggregate geometric mean is reported.
parent_comparison: Retain all paired comparisons against the scaled Peri-RMS parent in addition to baseline and LR x2.
full_suite_policy: Evaluate all 75 paired short cells for every candidate that advances. Prefer complete coverage, then lower full-suite geometric-mean epochs. Compare against both original baseline and LR x2; include all per-task medians/worst cases, slower seeds and censoring. If no candidate improves on LR x2, retain the incumbent and report the negative results.
long_policy: Complete the requested next mechanism before final short-only selection. A newly selected winner receives one reused 30-cell long diagnostic, without tuning or reselection.
invariants: Unchanged frozen model sources, task manifest, data, seeds, batch order, dimensions, dtype, warmup, weight decay, evaluation cadence and update budgets; separately archived code/configuration for every new output directory.
execution_order: Complete the already running LR x1 centering screen, preserve its results, then integrate/test/freeze SSMax and run its screen. Develop SSMax outside the frozen Python source trees in the meantime.
qk_ablation: Explicit user request: test SSMax with and without Q/K RMS. The second arm bypasses only the two parameter-free Q/K RMS operations; it keeps the same fixed attention temperature, initialization, LR, visible-key scale and all other modules. Compare the two arms directly. No extra rescaling is silently substituted.
